xr-modal.title: WebGL Required
xr-modal.message: AR and VR are not supported on the WebGPU renderer. Pressing OK will reload the viewer with WebGL.
walk-hint.desktop: Click to walk. WASD to move freely.
walk-hint.touch-tap: Tap to walk. Drag to look around.
walk-hint.touch-gaming: Use the joystick to move. Drag to look around. Tap to jump.
artlight.low-precision-picking: This device lacks high-precision picking: measurements use a slower fallback, accurate to a few millimetres.
artlight.point.title: XYZ points
artlight.point.empty: Click or tap the model to place a point.
artlight.point.help: Click a row to copy {axes}. Drag a point to move it, Delete removes the selected point, right-click or Esc clears all.
artlight.coords.height-ellipsoid: H: ellipsoidal height (WGS84), not NGF altitude: about 50 m apart in Provence.
artlight.zero.pick-zero: Click the point of the model to use as zero (Esc to cancel).
artlight.zero.pick-axis: Click a second point: the X axis will pass through it (Esc to cancel).
artlight.zero.axis-vertical: Point is directly above or below the zero: pick another one
artlight.coords.height-ngf-converted: H: NGF-IGN69 altitude, converted from ellipsoidal height with the IGN RAF20 grid (within a few cm).
artlight.coords.height-loading: Loading the NGF grid… H stays ellipsoidal meanwhile.
artlight.coords.height-uncovered: H: ellipsoidal height (WGS84). The scene is outside the NGF-IGN69 grid (mainland France): no conversion.
artlight.coords.height-error: H: ellipsoidal height (WGS84). The NGF grid could not be loaded: no conversion.
artlight.flatness.hint.idle: Click the corners of the area to analyse.
artlight.flatness.hint.more: Click the next corners ({n} more at least).
artlight.flatness.hint.close: Click the first corner or press Enter to close the area.
artlight.flatness.hint.closed: Drag a corner to adjust the area · Esc to clear.
artlight.flatness.title: Flatness
artlight.flatness.banner.lod-loading: loading the finest level of detail…
artlight.flatness.rule-status.no-data: not enough points under the straightedge
artlight.flatness.reference.label: Reference plane
artlight.flatness.reference.mean-title: Flatness: deviations from the plane that best fits the surface
artlight.flatness.reference.horizontal-t: Level: deviations from a horizontal plane at the median height of the area
artlight.flatness.reference.vertical-tit: Plumb: deviations from a vertical plane at the median position of the area
artlight.flatness.reference.only-mean: Best-fit plane: the surface is neither horizontal nor vertical (more than 10° off).
artlight.flatness.info.hatching: Hatching: areas without points, estimated values
artlight.flatness.warn.scale-noise: Scale finer than the survey noise: the map mostly shows noise.
artlight.flatness.lod.finer: finest that could be loaded for this area ({range}, 0 = finest)
artlight.flatness.lod.warn-loading: Provisional measurement on the displayed level of detail: loading the finest level.
artlight.flatness.lod.warn-finer: Area too large for level of detail 0: measured on the finest level that could be loaded. A smaller area will be more accurate.
artlight.flatness.lod.warn-too-large: Area too large to load the finest level of detail: measured on the displayed level. Move closer for more accuracy.
artlight.flatness.lod.warn-failed: Finest level of detail unavailable: measured on the displayed level. Move closer for more accuracy.
artlight.flatness.rule.zone-title: The straightedge spans the area from edge to edge (sagging of a roof slope)
artlight.flatness.rule.no-data: Not enough measured points under the straightedge to conclude.
artlight.flatness.rule.too-small: The area is shorter than the straightedge ({length}) in every direction.
artlight.flatness.rule.too-coarse: Survey not dense enough for this straightedge ({length}): the cloud only allows {cell} cells, at least {n} are needed under the straightedge.
artlight.flatness.rule.trace: White line: least favourable position ({how}, 8 directions, {cell} cells).
artlight.flatness.rule.warn-noise: Tolerance finer than the gap produced by the survey noise (≈ {value}): unreliable verdict.
artlight.flatness.scale.label: Colour scale (±)
artlight.flatness.band.label: Analysed thickness around the best-fit plane
artlight.flatness.band.title: Splats further from the best-fit plane are ignored (objects, roof framing, vegetation…)
artlight.flatness.wave.label: Smooth out tiles
artlight.flatness.wave.title: Removes the undulation of tiles or corrugated sheeting to keep only the shape of the slope. Choose the largest visible dimension of a tile, often its length (30 to 40 cm): the overlaps undulate too.
artlight.flatness.wave.note-zone: To measure the sagging of a slope, choose the "Area" straightedge (Straightedge tab).
artlight.flatness.wave.note-size: Set to the largest visible dimension of a tile (often 30 to 40 cm).
artlight.flatness.hidden.label: Ignore reflections
artlight.flatness.hidden.title: A varnished floor, glossy tiles or a window create ghost splats behind the surface (the reflection). They are discarded: only the layer visible from the viewer is measured.
artlight.flatness.fill.label: Fill gaps
artlight.flatness.export.png-note: Map, legend, scale and results in one image, for a report.
artlight.flatness.export.csv-note: One row per cell: position in the displayed frame and deviation in mm, for Excel.
artlight.flatness.export.copy-note: Results to the clipboard, to paste into Excel or Word.
artlight.flatness.png.title: Flatness — {scene}
artlight.flatness.png.view: Map seen from the viewpoint of the computation. White line: least favourable straightedge position.
artlight.flatness.png.hatching: Hatching: areas without points, estimated values.
